label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
body: CRO is the process of improving your website or landing page to increase the percentage of visitors who complete a desired action.
caption:
Imagine your online shop gets 100 visitors, and 2 buy something. That's a 2% conversion rate. With CRO, you tweak things like button colors or product descriptions to see if you can get 3 or 4 buyers from those same 100 visitors. It's about getting more out of what you already have without needing more traffic. Think about one small change you could test on your site today!
